title: Oximes of 2-bromo-5-nitroaryl carbonyls in base and after O-acetylation: intramolecular SNAr, the Kemp elimination, dehydration to the nitrile and ester hydrolysis
summary: Four reactions of one ring - Br ortho to an oxime, NO2 para to the Br - run at two levels at once. A 3-D reach scan turns the side chain about the ring-C bond and shows that only a Z oxime's oxygen can come within contact of the C-Br carbon; then each flask runs with every electron pair pushed as a curved arrow: deprotonation, intramolecular SNAr through a Meisenheimer complex, bromide loss, the Kemp elimination of the 3-H benzisoxazole to 2-cyano-4-nitrophenoxide (P); O-acetylation and anti E2 to 2-bromo-5-nitrobenzonitrile (Q); SNAr to 3-methyl-5-nitro-1,2-benzisoxazole with no Kemp elimination (R); and hydrolysis of the E O-acetyl ketoxime to the E oxime (S). An analysis bench (A380, AgBr, IR C#N) and a graph match to List-II give option (B).
subject: Chemistry
topic: Reactions of oximes - intramolecular nucleophilic aromatic substitution, Kemp elimination and dehydration of O-acyl aldoximes to nitriles
subtopics: E/Z isomerism of oximes and its consequences
Intramolecular SNAr of o-halo aryl oximes to 1,2-benzisoxazoles
Activation of SNAr by a para-nitro group (Meisenheimer complex)
O-Acetylation of oximes and anti elimination of O-acyl aldoximes to nitriles
concepts: C=N does not rotate: only a Z oxime O (syn to the ring) can reach the ortho C-Br carbon; an E oxime O never can
Intramolecular SNAr needs the ring activated: the NO2 para to Br takes the Meisenheimer charge
A 1,2-benzisoxazole with H on C3 is opened by base (Kemp elimination) to a 2-cyanophenoxide; with CH3 on C3 it survives
O-Acetylation removes the nucleophile; an O-acetyl aldoxime loses AcOH by anti E2 to the nitrile
An O-acetyl ketoxime in aqueous carbonate is only hydrolysed; the C=N geometry is kept
The amide (3) is a Beckmann product - it needs acid, not base
formulas: d(O...C2) < 3.22 A (C + O van der Waals contact) - Z oxime: comes within contact in a rigid-rotation model (so the atoms can meet); E oxime: never nearer than 4.2 A

derivedQuantities.P: Z aldoxime + NaOH: intramolecular SNAr -> 5-nitro-1,2-benzisoxazole -> Kemp elimination -> 2-hydroxy-5-nitrobenzonitrile, List-II (1)
derivedQuantities.Q: O-acetylation, then anti E2 with Na2CO3 -> 2-bromo-5-nitrobenzonitrile, List-II (2)
derivedQuantities.R: Z ketoxime + NaOH: intramolecular SNAr -> 3-methyl-5-nitro-1,2-benzisoxazole (no H-3, no Kemp), List-II (4)
derivedQuantities.S: E O-acetyl ketoxime + Na2CO3(aq): ester hydrolysis only -> E ketoxime, List-II (5)
derivedQuantities.reach_Z: within contact (< 3.22 A) in a rigid-rotation model

methods: Solved independently before any key was consulted: P1, Q2, R4, S5 - option B

RDKit structure edits for every transformation (SNAr ring closure, Kemp elimination, O-acetylation, anti E2, ester hydrolysis, Beckmann control), each product sanitised and matched to List-II by isomeric canonical SMILES

Geometry: ETKDG + MMFF conformers with a rigid torsion scan - the Z oxime O comes within the 3.22 A C + O contact of C2, the E oxime O never nearer than 4.25 A; C=N stereo from CIP labels and 3-D dihedrals
Activation: RDKit resonance enumeration of the Meisenheimer complex - charge reaches the nitro oxygens only for para/ortho NO2; meta control cannot
Arrow-pushing ledger written separately from the page: valence and total charge after every step
Distractor audit of all four options and controls (E aldoxime, meta-NO2, Z O-acetyl ketoxime, Beckmann of E and Z ketoximes) in tests/verify_p1q16.py
The page's own engine extracted and run in Node by the verifier: same matches and option
Headless-browser suite tests/sim_p1q16.js drives the finished page and the app shell
Official final key printed with the paper, checked afterwards: Q16 -> B
Published solution (MathonGo): not consulted - access for Claude Code is an open decision (docs/DECISIONS.md)
verification.note: Verified by independent derivation, scripts and the official key; reviewed and approved by the owner on 2026-09-29. Absorbances (A380, epsilon about 1.6e4 M-1 cm-1 for 2-cyano-4-nitrophenoxide) and flask time scales are representative. The page's reach model is a rigid-rotation, planar geometry (a value below contact means the atoms can meet, not a real distance) (C-C 1.39, C1-C7 1.48, C=N 1.28, N-O 1.40 A).
